## About the company

WeMee transforms ordinary gifts into unforgettable brand moments—crafted with style, purpose, and a personal touch. As a trusted corporate gifting partner, we help businesses elevate employee engagement, strengthen client relationships, and bring their brands to life through thoughtfully delivered, high-quality merchandise.

🎁 Whether you're onboarding new hires, celebrating milestones, hosting events, or engaging clients, we offer customized, scalable, and print-perfect gifting solutions—powered by our in-house printing excellence and premium packaging standards.

🏆 Why Leading Brands Choose WeMee
✔️ 1000+ customizable gifts – Apparel, Kits, Eco-merch, Gadgets, Diaries & more
✔️ Premium packaging – Sustainable, branded & unforgettable
✔️ Pan-India & Global delivery – Fast, reliable, trackable
✔️ End-to-end support – From consultation to doorstep
✔️ Eco-conscious – Plastic-free & planet-friendly options

🎁 Trusted for Every Occasion
✅ Onboarding kits – Branded experiences that welcome right
✅ Festival gifting – Diwali, Holi, Women’s Day, New Year & more
✅ Branded merchandise – Logo mugs, tees, gadgets, diaries & bags
✅ Client gifting – Thoughtful tokens that build loyalty
✅ Procurement-friendly – Seamless ordering & customization

🌍 Our Clientele: Trusted by 500+ Clients Across India
Some of our priviledged clients - GreeksforGreeks, Google Cloud, gslabs, VJ- Vilas Javdekar, Developers, Pune Metro, SAP, Amul- The Taste of India, Bajaj Finserv, Blazeclan, Vadilal, TEDx, TCS- Tata Consultancy Services, Microsoft, TATA Technologies, TATA Power, Oracle, MIT- ADT University, HR consultancies, MSMEs, and event planners across India.
